d: Mike finds an Alfa Romeo GTV with some fails, but he reckons Elvis can sort it. Can he get it ready for an Italian road trip to re-create the GTV Cup.
Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut. Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing. Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black paydirt.
As America marks its 250th birthday, Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne investigate reports of Revolutionary War ghosts in Pennsylvania.
For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his favourite movie.
Bruce Crompton marks the 75th Anniversary of VE Day, sending rare German halftrack vehicles to partake in a battle re-enactment. In France, he seeks VE Day relics.
Sig must choose between traditional grounds or taking a risk out west. A rumoured billion-dollar bounty lures crews beyond the bounds of rescue.
As America marks its 250th birthday, Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne investigate reports of Revolutionary War ghosts in Pennsylvania.
For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his favourite movie.
In Arizona, the Raneys confront a family more focused on building a social media brand than surviving brutal summer heat and deadly monsoon floods.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Honda NSX. In Japan, Mike and Elvis take on a dream car, a 1990s Honda NSX. But a fundamental issue brings one of their biggest challenges ever.
How do they build a tractor every three minutes to power Indian agriculture? How do they cast the bronze bells that help Swiss farmers keep track of their cows.
How do they collect millions of real birds' nests to make birds' nest soup? Plus, how do they use aerospace technology to make rowers go faster.
How do they quadruple the power of the world's biggest engines with the most powerful turbochargers? How do they build new roads from old waste plastic.
How do they harness the wind to power a racing yacht to Olympic gold? How do they make a sword fit for an officer at the world's largest sword factory.
Dr. Jeff preps a Shiba Inu struck by a car for surgery, but test results reveal a grim reality. Dr. Baier performs his first-ever wild goose operation.
Dr. Jeff and the team transform an abandoned restaurant in an old mining town into a clinic to serve the mountain community. And, Dr. Baier treats a sneezing parrot.
Shark Buffet! Wayde and Brett build a giant bar aquarium for the owners of Creek Casino in Alabama. This tank marks ATM's 10,000th tank and is one of the largest they've ever built.
The Dieselsellerz SEMA build hits a snag, and the guys rush to find a replacement. They decide to rebuild and give away their most iconic build - The Megaram.
A client asks for the biggest build yet: a monster school bus capable of driving over sand and water. The Muscle brings in a build for a gym buddy- a Raptor-style F250.
The crew race to finish the monster school bus with a 40-foot drive train and 66-inch tyres. Redbeard discovers the Mello Yello race car from Days of Thunder.
Major league pitcher Jacob deGrom asks the crew to revamp his OBS Ford. And, they convert a rare British Land Rover Defender from right-hand to left-hand drive.
The guys convert a rare Land Rover Defender from right hand drive to left. Plus, Heavy D tries to get money for the shop by parting out a military plane de-icer.
The crew overhaul a truck for a local dad whose F350 broke down. And, they assemble the shop's first-ever diesel motorcycle, with a Magneto.
Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut. Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing. Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black paydirt.
A couple bought a derelict cabin in a bid to keep the area's fly-fishing traditions alive. Chase and his team aim to repair it in just 11 weeks.
A family sets out to build an underground home in Idaho. Before they even pour concrete, they face a decision that will make or break their build.
Starting At The End Of Days. In a scorched wasteland, 12 battle-tested veterans scavenge the ruins to survive. A rogue elephant forces a camp to make shelter from junked cars.
As America marks its 250th birthday, Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne investigate reports of Revolutionary War ghosts in Pennsylvania.
For the 40th Anniversary of The Goonies, Josh braves the Oregon coast to search for the real-life pirate treasure that inspired his favourite movie.
The team goes to Nottingham, home to the legend of Robin Hood, to investigate whether centuries of bloodshed have left a paranormal legacy of terror.
The team continues to explore the legend of Robin Hood, following reports of hostile ghosts in a medieval prison and pagan rituals in Sherwood Forest.
After unthinkable tragedy, a family pleads for the Raneys to save a homesteader living alone in the mountains using skills he learned online.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Suzuki Cappuccino. Mike and Elvis are in Nagano to transform a cute old Suzuki Cappuccino, one of Japan's famed ultra-compact 'Kei cars', into a drifting track-star.
Mike spots a bargain supercar: a Maserati 4200GT for under £10k! Under the hood is a Ferrari V8, but can Elvis fix the potentially costly gearbox and clutch issues.
Mike and Elvis tackle a classic Toyota Landcruiser. Mike takes a gamble and imports an original 70s one from Japan, not knowing what state it will arrive in.
Mike tracks down one of the most iconic estate cars of all time, the Volvo 240 Torslanda, but it's seen better days. Elvis gets creative with metal to revive it.
With the Ford Focus having its 25th anniversary, Mike thinks the ST model may be the next classic. He nabs a bargain, but Elvis finds the engine needs a full rebuild.
Mike finds the perfect starter classic, a 1989 Audi Coupe. This rare car has a low mileage, but it's failed its MOT. The guys fix it up before a test drive in Cornwall.
Friends and natural builders deal with Mother Nature to construct a family adobe dome home using the earth onsite in a mountain range in California.
A young couple sets out to create their dream treehouse retreat in Northern Georgia overlooking the breath-taking Blue Ridge Mountains.
Any building project is stressful, especially if the build is in the middle of nowhere. A family builds on their 46-acre land by the Smoky Mountains.
A Big Island family finds their off-grid paradise threatened by destructive storms and deadly pests. To save them, the Raneys must get creative.
A Florida homestead is devastated by flooding and alligators. The Raneys find inventive ways to protect the homestead and bring in new food sources.
The Raneys arrives at a homestead threatened by heat, coyotes and even cows. Disaster strikes when Marty attempts to protect livestock with a massive build.
The Raneys arrives at a homestead with a bee-obsessed owner unintentionally attracting bears with his hives. Plus, dangerous winds threaten the bathhouse.
The team transforms the Boneyard, covering one wall with multi-coloured barn wood. Mark explores a German house barn and visits a log home built along a cliff.
In Ystad, Stefan chases a smuggler who's trying to escape. At Arlanda, Mimmi scans a bag and finds what looks like drugs.
A look at the daily challenges of the hard-working men and women in charge of the operations at some of the busiest harbours in Spain.
A look at the daily challenges of the hard-working men and women in charge of the operations at some of the busiest harbours in Spain.
A returning client is back with another classic, a 1965 Mustang Fastback. He likes to keep a stock look, but with updated drivetrain and modern amenities.
A series of terrifying encounters has renewed fears of the legendary Skinwalker. Searching for answers, Phil and Heather travel to the Navajo Nation.
Reports of hostile spirits draw Phil and Heather to Guam, where they investigate hauntings linked to the island's brutal World War II history.
In Montana, a family's friends call the Raneys to save them before La Nina weather strands them without a suitable cabin or food storage to survive.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
Lancia Delta Integrale. Italian rally legend Miki Biasion joins the boys as they transform a Lancia Integrale, like the one Miki drove to World Rally gold in the '80s.
Tracy Morgan's Giant Shark Tank Under Construction. Actor Tracy Morgan wants to swim with his huge sharks, so he wants the guys to tank his entire pool house.
Tracy Morgan's Giant Shark Tank Revealed! Tracy Morgan is still waiting for his shark tank. The pressure is on to convert his entire pool house into a huge 14,000-gallon aquarium.
Rick hunts giant nuggets in Deno Creek, but disaster strikes with his new wash plant. Parker feels the strain and with no water licence Tony is in crisis.
After Billy is offered a deal on one-of-a-kind boat, the Brown family is faced with a life-changing decision. Meanwhile, Noah kindles a new relationship in town.
Skippers Sig and Phil try to re-exchange their deckhands in a high seas transfer. But when both fall into the freezing water it's a race to fish them out.
Game Warden. The Texas Game Wardens are called when a nuisance alligator gets too close for comfort. Later, a suburban squirrel hunter is caught trespassing.
The Texas Game Wardens go undercover to catch someone selling illegal alligator parts. A tip leads to an angler with multiple undersized fish.
How do they keep you comfortable, entertained and safe with the latest aircraft seats? And, how do they design bras with aerospace technology to give you that extra lift.
How is plasterboard made from power station smoke? How do they cast the world's top awards? How do they build a plane that can take off and land almost anywhere.
How do they make car windows to keep out wind and rain, stones and thieves, and even noise and harmful UV rays? And, how do they put the gloss on lipstick.
How do they make George Washington's favourite tipple? How do they crash test aircraft seats without crashing a plane? How do they produce billions of batteries a year.
A daughter pleads for help from the Raneys to rescue her mother and stepfather whose failing homestead in Arizona faces deadly monsoon floods and a menacing cougar.
In the Smoky Mountains, the Raneys visit a homestead on the brink of collapse. They race to establish a viable homestead before the next big storm.
Mike surprises Elvis with a Caterham Seven, but the size of the restoration job is bigger than expected. Can they get it race-worthy in time.
Chase and his crew help a newlywed couple take a questionable 'wedding gift' and turn it into an alpine ski bungalow that would rival those in the Swiss Alps.
Tim and Tickle run Revolutionary War-era shine. Mark attempts his ancestor's sour corn whiskey recipe. Josh and Jerry's plans blow up in their faces.
Joined by Jack Osbourne, Heather investigates the eerie ghost town of Vulture City, where Gold Rush-era spirits hint at a far older evil.
Bruce is asked to find World War Two spy items that help tell the story of Ian Fleming and James Bond. First, he visits a debonair dealer in London.
